svg.text: Infinity-Context Plane 3 (crates/icx-hdc): Dual Hypercube Geometries
Discrete 10,240-Bit Boolean Hypercube Q_10240 ({0,1}^10240) + Continuous 16-D Fractal IFS Hypercube ([-1,+1]^16)
1. Discrete Boolean Hypercube Q_10240 = {0, 1}^10240
#[repr(C, align(64))] pub struct Hypervector { pub words: [u64; 160] }
• Vertex Space: 2^10240 ≈ 10^3082.5 vertices (1,280 B = 20 AVX-512 ZMM regs)
• Seed Mapping: BLAKE3 XOF("ICX_HDC_10240_V1:" || domain || "::" || symbol)
Isometric Automorphisms of Q_10240 (Coxeter Group B_10240)
• Hamming Metric: d_H(A, B) = Σ_{w=0..159} popcnt(A[w] ^ B[w])
• XOR Binding: bind(A, B) = A ⊕ B (GF(2)^10240 translation, self-inverse)
• Permutation: permute(A, k) = Π^k(A) (Coordinate axis shift in S_10240)
• Exact Isometry: d_H(A ⊕ C, B ⊕ C) = d_H(A, B) & d_H(Π^k A, Π^k B) = d_H(A, B)
Concentration of Measure on Q_10240 (Binomial(10240, 1/2))
• Expected Equator Distance: μ = D/2 = 5,120 bits
• Standard Deviation: σ = √(D/4) = √2560 ≈ 50.5964 bits (0.494% of D)
• Hoeffding Tail Bound: P(|d_H - 5120| ≥ 512) ≤ 2·exp(-51.2) ≈ 1.16e-22
• Normalized Similarity: sim(A, B) = 1 - min(d_H(A,B), 5120) / 5120 ∈ [0, 1]
2. Continuous 16-Cube [-1, +1]^16 (Fractal Chaos-Game)
pub struct FractalCoord { pub coords: [f64; 16], pub depth: u32 }
• Ambient Polytope: Centered 16-cube [-1, +1]^16 with 2^16 = 65,536 corners
• Projection Q_10240 → {-1,+1}^16: 16 blocks × 10 u64 words (640 bits/block)
Contractive Iterated Function System (IFS) Dynamics
• Closed-Form Series: z_t = Σ_{i=0..t-1} (1/2)^{i+1} v(s_{t-i})
• Nested Sub-Hypercubes: Last k steps confine z_t to a sub-16-cube of side 2^{1-k}
• Octal / Quadrant Code: 16-bit sign mask → AHTL @o1:o2 & Braille Channel B
O(1) Chebyshev (L_∞) Suffix Theorem on [-1, +1]^16
• Chebyshev Metric: d_∞(z_a, z_b) = max_{j ∈ 0..16} |z_{a,j} - z_{b,j}| ∈ [0, 2]
• Shared Suffix Depth: L_shared = ⌊ -log_2( d_∞(z_a, z_b) / 2 ) ⌋ ∈ [0, 32]
• Execution Latency: < 10 ns per pair (16 FP64 sub/abs/max operations)
• Telepathy Bus Export: to_q15() quantizes [-1,+1]^16 → [i16; 16] (32 bytes)
